name: T-Drones VA17
description: tilt-rotor, 3 rotors, 3.4 kg MTOW, 0.9 kg max payload. Parameters derived from published data; see provenance.

provenance.wind_rating_beaufort: referenced — level 5 wind resistance. Beaufort 5 is a band; the limit is read at its lower edge
provenance.m_tow: derived — 4.3 kg MTOW minus 0.9 kg payload = 3.40 kg empty. RAPTOR adds payload on top of this, so the field holds the empty mass, not the MTOW
provenance.S_ref: derived — b^2/AR with b = 1.68 m (referenced) and AR = 7.5 (assumed), giving 0.376 m^2 and a mean chord of 0.224 m
provenance.AR: assumed — 7.5, read from the airframe's proportions; not published. Wing loading follows at 9.0 kg/m^2, which is the number to sanity-check
provenance.n_rotors: referenced — 3, from the published configuration (tilt-rotor, 3 rotors)
provenance.rotor_diameter_m: assumed — 0.406 m (16 in), the usual size for this mass class; not published. Gives a disk loading of 8.8 kg/m^2 against the 5-15 kg/m^2 that multirotors of this class run
provenance.rotor_parking: referenced — tilted — follows from the configuration, not a free choice
provenance.cell_chemistry: referenced — li-ion — from the pack the manufacturer specifies
provenance.cell_capacity_ah: assumed — 4.2 Ah — the manufacturer does not say which cell the pack is built from, so a Molicel INR21700-P42A is assumed. It implies 2.8 parallel strings, which is what divides the pack's internal resistance
provenance.battery_mass: derived — 347 Wh at 195 Wh/kg pack level = 1.78 kg, which is 41% of the 4.3 kg MTOW. That is 1.55 kg of cells plus 15% for wiring, BMS and case
provenance.specific_energy: derived — 195 Wh/kg at pack level = 224 Wh/kg of cells divided by 1 + 0.15 of overhead
provenance.battery_capacity_mah: derived — none of the listed options (14.5 Ah) fits inside the published 3.40 kg empty mass once pack overhead is counted; 11.6 Ah is what the budget allows — 11.6 Ah, giving 347 Wh at a 3.732 V measured mean cell open-circuit voltage
provenance.cell_internal_resistance_ohm: assumed — 25 mOhm DC for one Molicel INR21700-P42A. Over 8S2.8P that is 72 mOhm at the pack, which sets voltage sag at hover current. Measure it if the pack is in hand
provenance.eta_cruise: assumed — 0.55, well below a lift+cruise machine's. A tilt-rotor's cruise propellers are the hover rotors: large diameter, low pitch, sized for static thrust. Run at cruise advance ratio they are badly off-design. The tilt-rotor pays here what a quadplane pays in parked-rotor drag
provenance.eta_vtol: assumed — 0.6, motor x ESC x propeller in the hover working point
provenance.geometry.fuselage_diameter: derived — 0.180 m, from the 0.9 kg payload's bulk at a cold-chain packing density; not published
provenance.geometry.boom_length: assumed — 0.924 m, 55% of span — the rotors sit outboard of the fuselage but well inboard of the tips
provenance.geometry.tail_area: assumed — 0.0414 m^2, 11% of wing area (horizontal plus vertical), a conventional tail volume for this layout
